085c8e5281695dd68bdce57e23dcd01f985aaede.caption: The closing animation of an accordion component in the STIHL Design System. The accordion-single component, in a medium size with the expansion indicator on the right, transitions from an expanded to a collapsed state. The animation involves three key actions: the content area height reduces from 100% to 0%, the opacity of the content within the content area fades from 100% to 0%, and the chevron icon rotates clockwise from 180° to 0°. The duration of this animation is 250ms with an easing function labeled motion-functional-ease-in.

4ab86c9be9d8cd6568f7129aef0969f139aef4bc.caption: Two instances of an accordion component in the medium size, with the expansion indicator on the right. 4c962ad49734dae49f763eb6db2824cad6cc364f.caption: An accordion component in a medium size, with the expansion indicator on the left, not expanded, and not flush. 522f88e99a512241a39402d92730f500baf50f77.caption: An accordion component in the STIHL Design System, specifically the medium variant. 608a02a419cbdb256a81d5571a4a236c5bb05457.caption: The opening animation of an accordion component in the STIHL Design System. The duration of the animation is 250ms with an easing type of motion-functional-ease-out, which also applies to the icon rotation.

63d0513bf6bdda182177aae46c27407ce7afe16f.caption: An "expandable section," a variant of the single accordion component.
